lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the reviewer's stale-cross-reference finding in docs/launch-readiness.md's 'Security / secrets: gap' section (was lines ~189-213, now ~189-212 after the edit): the paragraph and the 'bypassPermissions is the undisclosed default' bullet named the deleted `readPermissionMode`/`src/config/permission-mode.ts` module and claimed `cam init` writes a `permission_mode` key into `~/.config/cam/config.toml` (both false after US-001/US-002 of the parent PRD). Fix approach chosen: corrected the architecture description to the real hardcoded-at-every-spawn-site fact (named all 4 spawn sites: run.ts, setup.ts, sidecar.ts, plan-runner.ts, matching README.md's post-US-003 Security section wording) while explicitly PRESERVING the report's 'undisclosed / at the time of this audit / pre-CAM-331 README rebuild' framing everywhere else in the doc (the Concrete gaps bullets, the Prioritized gap triage item 1, the Go/no-go recommendation, and the Follow-up Issues section were all deliberately left untouched: they already read as historical, dated audit findings — 'as of this audit', 'No-go for public v1 as of this audit' — and none of them name the deleted module, so touching them was out of this story's narrow reviewer-finding scope and would have required a full-document consistency sweep). Earlier in this session I drafted a version that added 'this is now disclosed in README.md's Security section' language, then reverted it: that framing directly contradicted the untouched downstream triage/go-no-go/follow-up sections which still correctly call the gap open (this doc predates CAM-331/US-003's README Security section and is explicitly scoped 'pre-CAM-331 README rebuild' in its own header at line 16 — a future full-audit-refresh story, not this one, should update those sections if the report is ever re-run post-CAM-331). Verified no remaining references to `permission-mode.ts`/`readPermissionMode` anywhere in docs/, README.md, index.ts, or src/. scripts/cam/prd.json was already modified in the working tree at story start (supervisor-appended US-R1-001/002/003 review-round-fix stories plus renumbered priorities for existing US-001/US-002/US-003) — left untouched/unstaged per the standing rule that the implementer never edits prd.json.
